REVOLUTION ATX 3.1 1200 Watt 80 PLUS Gold Fully Modular ATX 3.1 Power Supply
Designed for next-generation performance, the REVOLUTION​ ATX 3.1 1200W power supply is fully compliant with Intel ATX 3.1 and PCIe 5.1 standards, outstanding stability and compatibility for the most demanding systems. Despite its compact footprint, it features fully modular cabling and boasts 80 PLUS®  GOLD certification for superior energy efficiency.
80 PLUS® GOLD CERTIFIED
REVOLUTION ATX 3.1 1200W power supply is 80 PLUS®  Gold certified with efficiency up to 93.5% on standard loading.
ATX 3.1 Certified — Built for High-Performance Systems
Engineered to handle up to 200% power excursion and near-instant power-on response, this PSU is built to support the latest high-performance GPUs. Included is a native 600W 12V-2X6 cable, providing seamless readiness for next-gen graphics cards.
Native PCIe 5.1 — Supports 12V-2x6 Standard Interface
Features the latest PCIe 5.1 compliant 12V-2x6 connector, fully compatible with NVIDIA RTX 50 series and future high-end GPUs. Delivers up to 600W of power output, enhanced for durability and safety to prevent connector overheating and unstable power delivery.
Semi -Fanless Technology
The built-in Semi-Fanless Technology ensures absolute silence under 20% load for a quieter computing experience
Half Bridge LLC Resonant Converter & DC to DC Circuit Design
This power supply features a high-efficiency Half-bridge LLC resonant converter combined with a DC-to-DC circuit design, delivering superior output efficiency and stable voltage regulation. Its single +12V rail supports higher current loads, reducing the risk of shutdowns during heavy usage.
Compact Size
With a compact 140mm chassis depth, it offers improved compatibility and easier installation in most mainstream PC cases.
Multiple Protection Circuitries
It also includes — OCP (Over Current Protection), OVP (Over Voltage Protection), UVP (Under Voltage Protection),OPP (Over Power Protection), OTP (Over Temperature Protection), and SCP (Short Circuit Protection) — ensuring a safe and reliable user experience.

Notice:For users that are looking to put in high end, power demanding GPU card, please connect 6 / 6+2P / 12V-2X6 12+4P PCIe connector(s) from your ENERMAX power supply to them correctly. This will prevent motherboard overloading and possibly cause damage to your system including your ENERMAX power supply. Once this occurs, it will be treated as improper system configuration and any damage on the power supply as a result of it, will not be covered under ENERMAX manufacturer’s warranty. Please refer to your motherboard & GPU card’s user manual to configure your system properly to prevent motherboard overloading damage to your system and your power supply.
Either sleeved or flat type modular cables in the box are all compatible with your newly purchased power supply. Please only use the modular cables provided in your ENERMAX power supply package. Do NOT use other modular cables to prevent pin configuration damage to your system and your power supply.
Info for DC connector’s rated current: The safety current is 6A per single DC wire. Please be noted that overloading could cause the connector or wire meltdown and could void the warranty.
